description: This source file defines a StorageService class responsible for storing session notes either locally on the filesystem or on OneDrive, depending on configuration. It includes methods for saving session notes, handling fallbacks, and integrating with Microsoft Graph API for cloud storage.

classes.name: StorageService
classes.description: A service class to store session notes either locally or on OneDrive, providing methods for saving notes with fallback and cloud integration.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] save_session_notes(self, session_id: str, notes: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Asynchronously saves session notes to configured storage provider and returns storage metadata.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _save_to_local(self, session_id: str, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Saves session notes to a local file and returns file path metadata.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _save_to_onedrive(self, session_id: str, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Asynchronously uploads session notes to OneDrive using Microsoft Graph API and returns item metadata.

methods.name: str _get_graph_token(self)
methods.description: Retrieves an OAuth access token for Microsoft Graph API using client credentials.
